CT.rules: An adult domestic cat of the stated build (standard, cobby, large longhair or slender), shown through body proportion, head shape, ears and tail rather than coat; four legs, five toes on each front paw and four on each hind paw where visible, one tail, two ears; hind legs bend backward at the hock.
CT.negatives: No kittens, no extra or missing legs or tails, no human-like posture, no clothing.

DG.rules: An adult dog of the stated build (small, short-legged, medium, large, sighthound or brachycephalic), with the proportions, ear set, muzzle length and tail type stated; the named breed is only a build reference, not a portrait of a show standard; four legs, one tail; hind legs bend backward at the hock.
DG.negatives: No puppies, no extra or missing legs or tails, no human-like posture, no clothing, no leash, no collar.

SM.rules: An adult small pet of the stated species with its correct body plan and leg count.
SM.negatives: No cages, no food, no extra or missing limbs, no clothing.

FA.rules: An adult horse or farm animal of the stated species; four legs with the correct joints (a horse's knee bends forward, its hock backward), one tail, correct hooves.
FA.negatives: No saddle, bridle, harness or rider, no cart, no slaughter or injury.

BD.rules: An adult bird of the stated species: two legs, two wings, one beak, correct wing shape and feather layout in silhouette.
BD.negatives: No perch, branch or cage, no extra wings or legs, no prey.

WL.rules: An adult wild animal of the stated species in a calm, natural posture with its correct body plan.
WL.negatives: No hunting, no prey, no blood, no bared fangs attacking, no injury, no captivity.

MY.rules: An original design of the stated mythical creature built from a coherent real-animal anatomy, with the body plan stated (number of legs, wings, horns, tails).
MY.negatives: Original design, not any existing game, anime, film or franchise creature; no rider, no armour, no fire or magic effects, no religious iconography.
